pronunciation: mai (rhymes with 'my', with a falling tone)

example.english: I'm going to the market to buy vegetables.

note: Hakka 買 (mâi) is a falling-tone word, while 賣 (mai, sold/selling) is a similar-sounding word with a different tone, so learners must pay attention to tone to avoid mixing up buying and selling. The pair 買賣 (mâi-mai) means 'trade' or 'business'.
